title: High-end packaging: 5 trends spotted at Luxe Pack Monaco 2026
summary: Refillability, distinctive materials, innovative decoration solutions, a lower environmental footprint, and evolving supply chains: at Luxe Pack Monaco 2026, high-end packaging manufacturers showcased innovations addressing the drive for premiumisation, changing consumer expectations, and new regulatory requirements.
